content: ACP v1 prompt-turn: on session/cancel the client SHOULD preemptively mark non-finished tool calls cancelled and MUST answer all pending session/request_permission with outcome cancelled; the agent MUST reply to session/prompt with stopReason cancelled (not an error), MAY emit session/update after cancel but before the prompt response; client SHOULD accept tool updates after cancel. Source: agentclientprotocol.com/protocol/v1/prompt-turn, /tool-calls.
